## Type of Contribution
- [ ] New resource page
- [ ] Major update / revision to an existing resource
- [ ] Minor fix / typo correction to an existing resource
- [ ] Added file blob/attachment (.gpx, .geojson, .docx, .xlsx, .pdf, etc.)
- [ ] Site documentation or structure improvement

## Contributor Checklist
- [ ] File is formatted as clean Markdown with YAML frontmatter at the top
- [ ] Follows the taxonomy in `docs/contributing/taxonomy.md` (proper tags, jurisdiction, category)
- [ ] Any referenced files or images are committed under `docs/assets/files/` or `docs/assets/images/`
- [ ] Links and spelling have been checked
- [ ] **If this is a new resource or major revision**:
    - [ ] Updated `date_updated: YYYY-MM-DD` in the page's YAML frontmatter
    - [ ] Added a dated 1-line operational entry in `docs/whats-new.md` (with links to article and PR/diff)
